## Summary

Pilkoji (the Grey One), last Mother of the wolves (*Vilkų Motina*), born c. 1365 (Q13), the first sworn woman; keeps the silver wolf and the pebble from Vytautas's body from 27 Oct to Kūčios (24 Dec) 1430, then gives both to the Flame-Keeper [Žiežirba](flame_keeper.qmd). She lies down in the oldest bog of the Dykra with the Iron Wolf's skull on Vėlinės, 2 Nov 1449 (Book V ch. 28).
